evals.prompt: Here are my reference samples and the mapped pixel counts per class. Give me area-adjusted accuracy and area estimates with 95% CIs.
expectations: Runs scripts/accuracy_assessment.py rather than computing by hand
Reports overall accuracy 0.947 with CI half-width ~0.018 and n=640
Reports estimated deforestation area ~235,086 px with CI ~68,418, distinct from the 200,000 mapped
Writes metrics.json with skill and skill_version fields

evals.prompt: Can you build a confusion matrix and tell me how good my land cover map is? samples.csv attached.
expectations: Asks for per-class mapped area before reporting area-adjusted accuracy
Does not report unweighted overall accuracy as the final answer

evals.prompt: Validate this forest change classification and write the methods and results paragraph for our report.
expectations: Produces a report.md section with Methods, Results and Limitations
Every number in the report appears in metrics.json
